_readme: The portrait factory's men (docs/briefs/portrait-factory.md; tools/characters/portrait.py). Each: `pictures`, a folder of four plain pictures (front, left, right, back: hatless, flat light, grey ground); `style`, what he should look like in the end, and `style_views` (front, three_quarter, side) where there are more (for the sheet, tools/characters/portrait_sheet.py); optional `macro` (MakeHuman macro targets for his build; else the factory's lean hard man's) and `outfit` (clothes.py's garments and colours). Output: assets/people/<id>_portrait.glb and its textures. `style_hair`: his style portraits' hair, where it differs from his plain pictures' (tools/characters/portrait_style.py paints it so).

bold_cowboy.style_hair: grey, thick and wavy, to his collar, as in his style portraits
bold_cowboy.what: a weathered frontier man of about forty, bare-headed, thick dark wavy hair to his collar, mutton-chop sideburns, a thick drooping moustache, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a black tie

older_heavyset_cowboy.what: a heavy-set frontier man in his late fifties, bare-headed, thick grey hair swept back to his collar, a big grey walrus moustache, heavy jowls and a broad face, a brown wool coat over a vest, a white shirt and a dark tie

young_lean_cowboy.what: a lean young frontier man of about twenty-two, bare-headed, tousled brown hair, clean-shaven with light stubble, a narrow face, a brown coat over a shirt with a red bandana at his neck

bold_cowboy_styled_30.note: The bold cowboy from his plain views repainted in the style (portrait_style.py, LoRA 0.3)

bold_cowboy_styled_60.note: The bold cowboy from his plain views repainted in the style (portrait_style.py, LoRA 0.6)

bold_cowboy_smooth.style_hair: grey, thick and wavy, to his collar, as in his style portraits
bold_cowboy_smooth.note: The bold cowboy with no squares on his face or hair (the smooth-faced test, docs/briefs/portrait-factory.md route 4).
